f4.quote: Exposure in oxidizing environments (e.g., air or controlled oxygen partial pressure) at temperatures in the range of 800–1200 °C over prolonged durations (100–500 hours), including cyclic thermal conditions to simulate service environments.

f6.quote: Preferential oxidation of Al and Cr at grain boundaries and defect sites leads to the rapid formation of a dense, adherent mixed oxide scale.

f7.quote: This oxide barrier slows further oxygen diffusion and self-heals minor cracks via continued adaptive oxidation.

f10.quote: Relative to the baseline MPEA with lower Al/Cr content, the modified alloy is expected to form an oxide scale that is thinner, more uniform, and more adherent, resulting in reduced weight gain and fewer instances of oxide scale spallation or cracking.
